unitTitle: Some - Any/Much - Many/A Few - A Little/Phrases of Quantity - Giving Advice - Conditionals Type 0 - Time Words

pairsWith.noteUz: should/shouldn't, 0-tur shart gap, vaqt so'zlari mashqlari va 1-6-unitlar takrori (Revision).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 6-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET + REVISION 1-6 (33-bet, PDF 32). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '6'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Fill in the gaps with should or shouldn't.' 1 You ...... eat lots of fruit and vegetables. 2 We ...... all drink at least four glasses of water per day. 3 You ...... talk with your mouth full. 4 "I have a test tomorrow." "You ...... stay at home and study." 5 Peter ...... eat so much junk food. 6 People ...... light fires in forests. 7 We ...... keep our neighbourhoods clean. 8 You ...... be quiet in a library. 9 Paul ...... drive carelessly. 10 "Tim isn't feeling well." "He ...... go to a doctor."
'Conditionals Type 0':
10) 'Match column A to column B.' A: 1 When I walk past the bakery 2 What colour do you get 3 If the temperature of water reaches 100°C, 4 When Mary has some free time after work 5 If you leave meat in the oven for a long time, 6 When Tom has a headache, 7 When it rains. B: a it boils. b she plays basketball with her friends. c he takes an aspirin. d people carry umbrellas. e when you mix yellow and blue? f I always buy a chocolate croissant. g it burns.
'Time Words':
11) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the future simple and underline the correct time word, as in the example.' 1 A: Can we start painting the house? B: No. We 'll paint (paint) it when/until I buy (buy) some paint. 2 A: I ...... (not/have) dinner as soon as/until you get home. B: Okay. I ...... (not/be) late.

O'NG USTUN:
3 A: If Jeff calls before/while I ...... (leave), let me know. B: Alright. 4 A: We ...... (have) a big party after/while he ...... (graduate). B: That's a great idea! 5 A: You forgot to put petrol in the car again. B: Oh, dear! I promise I ...... (do) it before/until I ...... (go) to work tomorrow morning. 6 A: ...... (you/visit) us while/when you ...... (be) in town? B: Of course I will. 7 A: I ...... (water) the plants when/while I ...... (finish) cooking. B: OK. 8 A: Is your dog dangerous? B: No, it isn't. It only ...... (bark) when/before it ...... (see) a stranger.
'Revision: Units 1 - 6':
12) 'Tick the correct sentences, as in the example.' 1 a) There aren't any tomatoes in the fridge. ✓ b) There aren't some tomatoes in the fridge. 2 a) What does your brother looks like? b) What does your brother look like? 3 a) Mary didn't used to live in Brighton. b) Mary didn't use to live in Brighton. 4 a) The yellow jumper is much cheaper than the red one. b) The yellow jumper is more cheaper than the red one. 5 a) I don't think the dog will attacks them. b) I don't think the dog will attack them. 6 a) Ruby was holding a beautiful bouquet of roses. b) Ruby was holding a beautifully bouquet of roses. 7 a) The kitchen tap was dripping all night long. b) The kitchen tap drips all night long. 8 a) When did the accident happened? b) When did the accident happen?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '33'.

exercises.explanationUz:

  FIKR (shouldn't)?

  2 SHOULD drink water
  3 SHOULDN'T talk with mouth full
  4 SHOULD stay at home and study
  5 SHOULDN'T eat junk food
  6 SHOULDN'T light fires in

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the future simple and underline the correct time word, as in the example. Example: A: Can we start painting the house? B: No. We'll paint (paint) it WHEN/until I buy (buy) some paint.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki future simple shaklida qo'ying va to'g'ri vaqt so'zini tanlang, namunadagidek. Namuna: A: Uyni bo'yashni boshlasak bo'ladimi? B: Yo'q. Bo'yoq sotib olganimda bo'yaymiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT SO'ZI + PRESENT SIMPLE;
  bosh gap + WILL.

  1 'll paint ... WHEN I buy
    (NAMUNA)
  2 won't have dinner UNTIL you get
    home / won't be late
  3 BEFORE I leave, let me know
  4 'll have a party AFTER he
    graduates
  5 'll do it BEFORE I go to work
  6 Will you visit us WHEN you are
    in town
  7 'll water the plants WHEN I
    finish cooking
  8 only barks WHEN it sees a
    stranger (0-tur - ikkala
    present)


⚠ 'PETROL':

  = benzin.


⚠ 'A STRANGER':

  = notanish odam.

patterns.exampleEn: People shouldn't light fires in forests. You should be quiet in a library.
patterns.exampleUz: Odamlar o'rmonda olov yoqmasligi kerak. Kutubxonada jim bo'lishingiz kerak.

patterns.formula: When / If + KIM + FE'L(s), KIM + FE'L(s) (0-tur)
patterns.exampleEn: When it rains, people carry umbrellas. If water reaches 100°C, it boils.
patterns.exampleUz: Yomg'ir yog'ganda odamlar soyabon ko'tarib yurishadi. Suv 100°C ga yetsa, qaynaydi.

patterns.formula: KIM + will + FE'L + before / after / when / until / as soon as + KIM + FE'L(s)
patterns.exampleEn: I'll do it before I go to work. We'll have a party after he graduates.
patterns.exampleUz: Ishga ketishimdan oldin qilaman. U bitirgandan keyin ziyofat qilamiz.
